title: Reel: 30 new ads, Meta saw one (the first-frame test)
caption:
30 new ads. Meta saw one.

We looked at every new video ad the brands we work with launched from May to September 2026. New ads that looked like ads already running got 36% less first-month spend. A proven message in a new look got 47% more.

The test to run before your next launch: line up the first frame of every ad with the sound off. If you can't tell two apart, that is one ad. Launch one.

Read the full newsletter on our website, link in bio.

script.setup: Idea: a growth lead who ships dozens of new ads a month and watches spend stay on the old ones learns what counts as new, and gets a test to run before launch. On-screen title: 30 new ads. Meta saw one. Expectation set: I will find out why my new ads get no spend. The script meets it in the first line, then beats it with two numbers from our own analysis and a ten-second test. Outline (new points only): look-alikes got less spend (our finding); a proven message in a new look got more (second-best, first); the first-frame line-up test (best, second).

scenes.visual: Thirty ad tiles fill the screen. They differ only in background colour. They slide together into one tile.
scenes.voiceover: Thirty new ads, thirty chances? Meta's system saw one.

scenes.visual: A calendar strip runs May to September while small ad tiles drop into a pile.
scenes.voiceover: We checked every new video ad our brands launched, May to September.

scenes.visual: A spend bar for look-alike ads shrinks. Small source line: Galvor analysis, ads launched May–Sep 2026.
scenes.voiceover: Look-alike new ads got thirty-six percent less first-month spend.

scenes.visual: One ad tile changes its backdrop colour three times. The product and the framing stay the same.
scenes.voiceover: Swapping the backdrop still looks like the old ad.

scenes.visual: The same line of copy sits over a clearly different opening picture. A bar grows. Same source line.
scenes.voiceover: A proven message in a new look got forty-seven percent more.

scenes.visual: First frames of six ads snap into a row. A mute icon appears.
scenes.voiceover: So before launch, line up every first frame, sound off.

scenes.visual: Two near-identical frames pulse, then merge into one.
scenes.voiceover: Can't tell two apart? That's one ad. Launch one.

scenes.visual: The pile of thirty files shrinks to a short row of different first frames.
End card with the Galvor logo and a link-in-bio arrow. Chime.
scenes.voiceover: Read the full newsletter on our website, link in bio.

script.music: Light instrumental bed, low under the voice. Soft chime on the end card only.
script.notes: AI voiceover over motion graphics. No presenter and no first person singular. Captions burned in for muted viewing. Use dummy ad tiles only, never a client account or name. Newsletter reel, so the closing line is the newsletter line. Numbers: 36% less first-month spend for new ads that looked like many running ads; 47% more for a proven message in a new look. Both from Galvor's analysis of every new video ad launched May–Sep 2026 across brands we work with (Decoded #3). Show the source line on screen with each number.
